/* Checked-in fixture for test/docReviewLayerVisibility.test.js's mutation check (B884304).
 *
 * This is the REAL pre-fix `toggleLayer` body — sliced verbatim from
 * `src/workspaces/doc-review/DocReview.jsx` at commit
 * 09d9cf9da4159ae84c01bc8310ede7d344bee6df ("B500576 — three more ways a group bet refused every
 * save on a building, and the flag is now ON", #1045) via
 * `git show 09d9cf9d:src/workspaces/doc-review/DocReview.jsx`, never a paraphrase (a paraphrase
 * would only ever test the paraphrase). That commit predates B503184's fix, which added the
 * `detailTileRef.current = null` invalidation this guard exists to require.
 *
 * WHY THIS FILE EXISTS RATHER THAN A LIVE `git show 09d9cf9d:…`: 09d9cf9d IS an ancestor of
 * `origin/main`, so it is not at risk of the branch-pruning failure that hit
 * test/hiddenContentReads.test.js's own mutation check (B876256) — but it IS at risk of a
 * different, more common failure: a fresh agent container clones this repo shallow
 * (`git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch main`), and a shallow clone cannot resolve any
 * commit older than its single fetched tip. `git show 09d9cf9d:…` then fails with
 * `fatal: invalid object name '09d9cf9d'` even though the SHA is perfectly real on main — which
 * is exactly what happened, reported as B884304 after a session saw this red in its own shallow
 * container. Reading this checked-in copy instead means the mutation check no longer depends on
 * the running clone's fetch depth.
 *
 * Do not "clean up" this file to look like real, currently-buildable source — it is deliberately
 * the OLD, BUGGY body (never invalidates `detailTileRef`), which is the whole point: the guard
 * must prove `toggleLayerBody()` still finds it and `hasInvalidation()` still reports it as
 * NOT invalidating.
 */
  // B490: show/hide one PDF layer, re-read every row's visibility (a radio-button group flips its
  // siblings), then re-raster BOTH layers against the mutated config. View filter only — never the markups.
  const toggleLayer = (id, visible) => {
    const cfg = ocgConfigRef.current;
    if (!cfg) return;
    cfg.setVisibility(id, visible);
    setOcgLayers((rows) => deriveLayerVisibility(cfg, rows));
    setBackdropReq((n) => n + 1); setDetailReq((n) => n + 1);
  };
